patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Gong and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits. Choose Gong only if your buying job matches “Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal” rather than Instantly's shape. Choose Instantly only if your buying job matches “Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358” rather than Gong's shape. Workflow advantage: Gong leans lead-management; Instantly leans prospecting. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Gong and Instantly share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Gong is Conversation intelligence / revenue AI — per-user licenses + platform fee; custom proposal only (no public dollar list).; Instantly is Cold-email outreach infrastructure — Growth from $47/mo; Hypergrowth $97; Light Speed $358; bundles/credits add-ons; Enterprise custom..
- Company-size focus: Gong (mid-market, enterprise) vs Instantly (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Gong-leaning lead-management vs Instantly-leaning prospecting.
- Researched limits: Gong — Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Instantly — Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core.

Limitations — Gong: Separate job from sales intelligence contact databases; Not a prospecting/enrichment data core; Instantly: Cold-email infra first — not an SI contact-database core; Lead finder/credits are add-on depth vs dedicated SI databases.
